institutionName: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At det var et engelsktalende sprog, og at de havde et stort udvalg af kurser indenfor Exercise and Sports Science

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde en virkelig fed oplevelse, og kan kun anbefale andre at tage afsted.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Der er meget man skal have styr på, og man står ret meget på egne ben. Men tager man det en ting af gangen, er det til at finde ud af! Og så er der meget man først finder ud af når man er på værtsuniversitetet.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var kun et enkelt oplæg på 2 timer ca. 1 uge efter jeg ankom til USA. Derudover var man helt på egne ben. Men jeg fandt nogle andre udvekslingsstuderende, som jeg kunne spare med - det var super rart, så man kunne hjælpe hinanden!

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Der var ikke andet planlagt udover nævnte oplæg på 2 timer. Dog var der et udvekslingskontor, som var flittige til at svare på mail og telefon! Men med flere ting man bare finder ud af hen ad vejen og lærer fra de andre studerende!

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt at finde et sted at bo gennem en Facebookgruppe. Der er mange som fremlejer deres værelse.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
De fleste jeg kendte af udvekslingsstuderende boede på campus, og fortrød at de ikke valgte at bo off-campus.  
Det er ikke nødvendigvis dyrere, du kan selv lave mad og det giver større frihed eftersom du ikke nødvendigvis skal tage hensyn til en roommate på samme værelse.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde lejet et værelse gennem af en pige jeg fandt på Facebook som skulle fremleje hendes værelse - Kan virkelig anbefale at bo på Lark, hvis du skal til Chapel Hill NC.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var lidt besværligt lige at lære deres system at kende - det var en meget outdated side.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Når først man finder ud af systemet går det fint. Dog er der nogle kurser jeg ikke kunne få, uden der som sådan var en årsag - jeg kan anbefale at man kontakter underviseren direkte på mail.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var en video som kunne forklare det nogenlunde.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Der var mange kurser der allerede var bookede, da der blev åbnet for tilmelding for exchange students. Jeg fik 2 af de kurser jeg havde på min 1. prioritet, og resten var lidt af nød. Dog endte jeg med at blive meget glad for de fleste kurser!

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Forvent ikke at du kan få alle de kurser du læser om. Hver opmærksom på hvilket semester de udbydes og krav til kurset.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var i de fleste af mine kurser lidt lavere end på KU - Dog var der flere ugentlige opgaver, og andre krav fra underviserne.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Som elev følte jeg mig mere inkluderet i undervisningen. Der er større fokus på deltagelse fra eleverne.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
EXSS 141 Personal Health
EXSS 181 Sport and exercise psychology
EXSS 191 Theory and Practice of Modern Dance Technique - Elementary-Level Elective
LFIT 108 Life Fitness: Outdoor sports
SOCI 101 Sociological Perspectives

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Jeg synes at EXSS 181 var et rigtig godt kursus. Jeg var positivt overrasket over EXSS 191.
SOCI 101 er MEGET basic, men synes det var et godt fag. 
EXSS 141 var et nemt fag - ikke særlig spændende.

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Exchange Student fee

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det meste var som forventet - Lidt dyr husleje.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Man kunne se alle kampe i diverse sportsgrene - Kæmpe basketball-oplevelse. Jeg var selv med på håndboldholdet.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: At melde sig ind i en klub eller på et sportshold.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tage til bjergene og ud til kysten. Evt. tage til Washington DC, da det ikke er så langt væk.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det gik fint - man vender sig hurtigt til hverdagen.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Jeg boede sammen med 3 amerikanske studerende - vil jeg klart anbefale!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Madkulturen er en del anderledes end herhjemme, men der er også gode muligheder for indkøb.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At amerikanere er gode til at være spontane og snakke med nye mennesker.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Bo off-campus. Bo med amerikanere. Lær nogle udvekslingsstuderende at kende.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej ikke bestemt.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At komme væk fra hverdagen herhjemme, og blive sat i et nyt anderledes miljø med nye mennesker.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At bibeholde relationer derhjemme - Dog er FaceTime helt fantastisk, og det kan man nå langt med.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Hvis du er i tvivl om du vil afsted, så kan jeg anbefale at du kaster dig ud i det! Alt det praktiske skal man nok få styr på - det skal man ikke bekymre sig om.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
